title: tACS for Sensory Motor Recovery After Stroke
official: tACS Brain Neuromodulation for Sensory and Motor Recovery After Neurological Impairments
summary: The overall goal is to investigate the effectiveness of a novel intervention - transcranial alternating current stimulation (tACS) for motor recovery in stroke survivors.
sponsor: The University of Texas Health Science Center, Houston
